Group 1 Automotive Announces Hennessy Honda of Woodstock is now Group 1 Honda Woodstock
items.sum: In a strategic move to unify its extensive network of dealerships, Group 1 Automotive, Inc., a Houston-based automotive retailer with dealerships across the U.S. and U.K., announced that Hennessy Honda of Woodstock has been renamed Group 1 Honda Woodstock, following the company's acquisition of Hennessy Automobile Companies' Atlanta-market dealerships, which closed Oct. 19, 2026.

items.t: Honda Motor (TSE:7267) Is Spending $3 Billion On A New Ohio Plant
items.sum: Honda Motor (TSE:7267) plans to invest about US$3b in a new vehicle assembly plant in Ohio focused on hybrids and EVs. The Ohio facility is expected to feature flexible production lines for hybrid, gasoline, and battery-electric models aimed at North American buyers.
